text:
Dark mode is here for everyone

As of May 12, all of our users have dark mode. If you've wanted something easier on the eyes for late-night writing, you can turn it on in your settings.

You asked for it. During the beta, 38% of testers requested dark mode, more than asked for anything else. We wanted to do more than invert the colors, so we took our time with it.

We started with readability. Dark mode text has a 7:1 contrast ratio, which meets the WCAG AAA standard for normal text. Whether you're skimming a grocery list or reading through pages of meeting notes, your text stays sharp. We also re-tuned headings, links, highlights and code blocks so they still stand out against the darker background.

You can pick dark mode or light mode. You can also let the app follow your device's system setting, so it switches on its own as the day goes on.

Thanks to everyone who tested early builds and sent us feedback. Please keep sending it. A lot of our best features started as your suggestions.
